text: The Vidu open platform currently supports a wide range of features, covering video, audio, image, and creative use cases across various development scenarios. The function list is continuously updated: Primary Function Secondary Function Function Details Video Generation Image to Video Generate a video from an input image and prompt description Freely select the video's aspect ratio, duration, resolution, and motion amplitude Support for adding background music Support for selecting multiple generation modes Reference to Video Generate a video that references the subject or scene of input images Support for uploading multiple images Freely select the video's aspect ratio, duration, resolution, and motion amplitude Support for adding background music Support for selecting multiple generation modes Start-End Frame to Video Input a start frame image and an end frame image, and generate a video based on the prompt Freely select the video's aspect ratio, duration, resolution, and motion amplitude Support for adding background music Support for selecting multiple generation modes Text to Video Generate a video directly from a prompt describing the scene Support for long text descriptions Freely select the video's aspect ratio, duration, resolution, and motion amplitude Support for adding background music Support for selecting multiple generation modes Real-Time Interactive Digital Human Avatar Real-Time Edition Input an image, persona, and user audio/video for real-time conversation Real-time interaction where the digital human converses with the user in real time, supports interruption, and has bidirectional perception. Vidu S provides the full pipeline from speech to rendering Avatar Component Edition Generate real-time video by referencing digital human audio + action text Real-time interaction — you already have your own RTC channel and real-time voice capability; Vidu S only needs to render the digital human and stream it to your channel Avatar Non-Real-Time Edition Input a digital human image + digital human audio + action text to generate a video file Asynchronous generation — one character image + one audio clip (or text) generates a speaking video with aligned lip sync and movement Editing Edition Input a user audio/video stream + replacement image to generate a real-time video Streaming video editing: continuously receives a video stream and outputs the edited result in real time, with the ability to switch the reference image or scene mid-stream without interrupting the stream Image Generation Reference to Image Generate an image that references the subject or scene of input images Support for uploading multiple images Image characters, objects, and scenes remain highly consistent throughout Freely select the image's aspect ratio and resolution, with support for 2K and 4K Text to Image Generate an image directly from a prompt describing the scene Support for long text descriptions Freely select the image's aspect ratio and resolution, with support for 2K and 4K Image Editing Reference an original image and a reference image to replace elements in the original image Support for uploading multiple images Support for replacing elements in the original image via text description Freely select the image's aspect ratio and resolution, with support for 2K and 4K Audio Generation Text to Audio Generate audio directly from a prompt Support for generating creative sound effects or various types of background music Freely select the audio duration Controllable Text to Sound Effects Generate controllable, time-sequenced sound effects directly from a prompt Use a timeline to flexibly control the order and duration of multiple sound effects Support for overlapping multiple sound effects Freely select the audio duration Text to Speech Generate speech from text Control speech rate, pauses, volume, and polyphonic character pronunciation Freely adjust speech emotion, such as happy, sad, or angry Support for 30+ languages and 300+ voice options Voice Cloning Upload audio to clone a voice Invoke the cloned voice for speech synthesis at any time Freely adjust speech emotion, such as happy, sad, or angry Template Usage Scene Templates Input an image and apply an effects template with one click to generate a video Covers hundreds of creative templates: French kiss, journey through the universe series, and more Template-Based Compilations Input an image and apply a long-video template with one click to generate a compiled video The resulting compilation has a coherent storyline and diverse effects Additional Capabilities Lip Sync Make a character in a video lip-sync to a specified text Freely select from hundreds of voices and languages Support for long text input Freely adjust volume and speech rate Digital Human Generate a digital human video for a character in an image Enable the digital human to deliver speeches, broadcasts, and other content Support for speech synthesis using 300+ voices or cloned voices Video Extension Extend the duration of a video Support for extending by 1 to 7 seconds Smart Multi-Frame Input multiple keyframes to continue a video Use keyframes to generate high-quality videos with a coherent plot and consistent characters Freely control the duration between frames, selectable from 2 to 7 seconds Each frame can use a prompt to control the visual effect Recommended Prompts Input an image to generate corresponding recommended prompts Support for selecting the prompt type and quantity Support for selecting the video resolution Smart Ultra HD - Premium Enhance the resolution of a video Freely select from multiple resolutions: 1080p, 2K, 4K, 8K
